commit.messageHeadline: fix: keep required replies from disappearing after tool completion
fix: preserve group silence and plugin reply custody
fix: integrate reply recovery with current main
fix: preserve continuation delivery during reply recovery
fix: retain pending work and command reply completion
fix: keep terminal failures distinct from pending work
test: align approval fixtures with reply ownership
fix: preserve classified failures and optional group silence
fix: distinguish suppressed progress from visible failure context
fix: honor tool policy patterns during reply recovery
